title: Stonkz LITE
description: A market economy plugin where prices fluctuate automatically based on player trading volume.
body:
# Stonkz Lite
![Header Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AEjVKVLA/images/9e09d95ed893e1cbfd217b05ae52a8002e210f7e.png)
> **Stop Grinding. Start Trading.**
> A dynamic stock market economy for Minecraft. Prices rise when players buy and fall when they sell!
## ✨ Overview
Stonkz LITE is a complete replacement for generic shop plugins. Instead of static prices that lead to broken economies, Stonkz uses a **real-time supply and demand algorithm**.
Every item has a dynamic price. If players sell too much of an item (like Cobblestone or Iron), the price crashes. If an item is scarce, the price skyrockets. This creates a living, breathing economy where supply matters.
## 💡 Benefits
Most Minecraft servers suffer from **Hyper-Inflation**. Players make automatic farms, sell infinite items to the server shop, and money becomes worthless.
**Stonkz fixes this automatically.**
*   **No more inflation:** Prices drop when items are over-farmed.
*   **Player Engagement:** Players must watch the market to trade intelligently.
*   **Zero Maintenance:** The economy balances itself without admin intervention.
## 🚀 Key Features
*   📈 **Dynamic Pricing Engine** - Every single transaction impacts the price. Buy high, sell low!
*   🖥️ **Premium GUI** - Smooth, paginated, and intuitive menus.
*   ⚡ **Quick Commands** - `/buy`, `/sell`, `/sellhand` support.
*   💰 **Worth Display** - Hover over any item to see its live value.
*   🚨 **Panic Mode** - Market crashes automatically on rapid selling.
*   📦 **Pre-Configured** - 60+ vanilla items balanced out of the box.
![GUI Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AEjVKVLA/images/cdada001240d805125cf7f5fb70d21c14c6c1142.png)

## 🎮 Commands & Permissions
| Command | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/stonkz` | `stonkz.use` | Open the main market GUI |
| `/stonkz top` | `stonkz.top` | View top gainers/losers |
| `/stonkz search` | `stonkz.search` | Search for items |
| `/stonkz price` | `stonkz.price` | Check item price |
| `/buy` | `stonkz.buy` | Quick buy command |
| `/sell` | `stonkz.sell` | Quick sell command |
| `/sellhand` | `stonkz.sellhand` | Sell item in hand |
| `/stonkz admin` | `stonkz.admin` | Admin management |
![Configuration Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AEjVKVLA/images/86183f8ebec6f5c87f275a9f6cab834e2a30172e.png)
## 📋 Requirements
- **Java 21+** required.
- **Paper 1.20.1+** (or Folia) required.
- **Vault** & Economy plugin required.
- Works out of the box with default config.
